title: Watercolor "1,2,3 and to the Shore" 848 Western Lake Drive
h1: Watercolor "1,2,3 and to the Shore" 848 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Park District of WaterColor, steps from Seaside- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Screened-in porches both upstairs and downstairs- High-speed internet - Professionally decorated- Outdoor fireplace, seating area, and grill- 1 dedicated parking spot with additional parking throughout the community. - 5 adult bikes- 6-passenger golf cart - Complete Clean Linen Participant – ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: 1,2,3 and to the Shore is a 4–bedroom, 4–bathroom WaterColor. Guests will enjoy the home’s outdoor fireplace and sitting area and 2 large, screened porches. Located by the WaterColor Tennis Center and a few steps from a footpath that crosses into Seaside, this home has access to all of WaterColor’s amenities.A front porch gives guests the option to enter 1,2,3 and to the Shore through a screened side porch or the front door. After spending the day swimming and playing, the porch is a lovely spot to drop wet and sandy gear before heading inside. The porch has ceiling fans, a flat-screen TV, an outdoor living area, and a low table perfect for card games. Steps lead down to a courtyard with a huge outdoor fireplace, wrap-around couch, grill, and dining table. Inside the home is an open living, dining, and kitchen space. The professionally decorated interior has original artwork, hardwood floors, and premium appliances. A long waterfall island conceals multiple premium appliances and while providing seating for 5. Wine enthusiasts will appreciate the full-size wine cooler. French doors open to a guest bedroom with a king bed and a shared bathroom with a shower past the dining area. A back door opens to a wooden deck surrounded by native palmetto and scrub oak. An outdoor shower with louvered doors lets guests’ bathe in privacy.On the second floor are 3 bedrooms, a bonus room, and a screened porch. A primary bedroom has a king bed and enjoys lots of natural light. French doors open to a porch with a cushioned swing for 2. The bedroom’s private bathroom has a jetted soaking tub and a separate shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed and private bathroom with shower. A second guest bedroom also has a king bed, along with a private bathroom with a tub/shower combo. A bonus room has 2 twin–over–twin bunks. Across from the laundry room, French doors open to a screened porch with Adirondack chairs. Explore WaterColor and bike to the Beach Club on 5 included adult bikes. With a location like this, 1,2,3 and to the Shore won’t be available for long. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bonus Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsPlease note: Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
